translationRepairs: He then filled in the moat and built a causeway, set cannon on the ramparts, and prepared to storm the city.
He then filled in the moat and built a causeway, set catapults on the ramparts, and prepared to storm the city.
砲 in this siege is catapult artillery, not cannon.
Chishanhui defeated the Song at Pingjiang and took the city.
Chizhan Hui defeated the Song at Pingjiang and took the city.
赤盞 is the surname Chizhan. The given name is Hui.
Talan sent Yelagu from Tianchang to relieve Zongbi at Jiangning, while Wulindatai also marched to link up; together they repeatedly defeated Song forces.
Talan sent Yelagu from Tianchang to relieve Zongbi at Jiangning, while Wulinda Taiyu also marched to link up; together they repeatedly defeated Song forces.
烏林答泰欲 is the full name Wulinda Taiyu. The English cuts it.

Zongbi was caught in a tight encirclement. Hanchang took an arrow in the eye, wrenched it out in fury—blood streaming—and packed the wound with earth. Mounting again, he charged shouting and broke the ring, bringing both himself and Zongbi out alive.

Zongbi was caught in a tight encirclement. Han Chang took an arrow in the eye, wrenched it out in fury—blood streaming—and packed the wound with earth. Mounting again, he charged shouting and broke the ring, bringing both himself and Zongbi out alive.
韓常 is Han Chang, surname and given name.

Zongbi sent Kong Yanzou against Bian and Zheng, Wang Bolong to take Chenzhou, and Li Cheng to take Luoyang, while he led the main force to capture Bozhou and Shunchang. Song, Ru, and other prefectures fell in succession.

Zongbi sent Kong Yanzhou against Bian and Zheng, Wang Bolong to take Chenzhou, and Li Cheng to take Luoyang, while he led the main force to capture Bozhou and Shunchang. Song, Ru, and other prefectures fell in succession.
舟 is zhou. The English writes Yanzou.

Wulu and Tushi Xieye were then co-wives. Xieye's concubine Hutà had won favor with Tushi and reported to her, "Wulu's words smacked of resentment and even open criticism, and she had said Beidie was destined for greatness."

Wulu was then married to Tushi Xieye. Xieye's concubine Hutà had won favor with Tushi and reported to her, "Wulu's words smacked of resentment and even open criticism, and she had said Beidie was destined for greatness."
兀魯與徒單斜也為室 means Wulu was Xieye's wife. Co-wives misreads it.
He served in turn as regent of the Central and Eastern capitals.
He served in turn as regent of the Central Capital and Eastern Capital.
中京、東京 are the two capitals Zhongjing and Dongjing.
In cuju Heng was reckoned the finest player in the realm and often held his own against several opponents at once.
At polo Heng was reckoned the finest player in the realm and often held his own against several opponents at once.
擊鞠 is mounted polo. The sentences that follow describe riding.
Bangchang urged him to take the throne at Guide, but the King of Kang had already been proclaimed emperor and had him executed on a charge of concealing court secrets.
Bangchang urged him to take the throne at Guide, but the King of Kang had already been proclaimed emperor and had him executed on a charge of a hidden offense.
罪以隱事 means on a concealed charge. It does not say court secrets.
Before long, the Song Gate Guard Announcer Xu Wen defected with sixty vessels and more than seven hundred troops. Reaching the Mizhou border, he led his officers to Bian.
Before long, the Song emperor's Gate Guard Announcer Xu Wen defected with sixty vessels and more than seven hundred troops. Reaching the Mizhou border, he led his officers to Bian.
宋主閣門宣贊舍人 names an officer of the Song emperor.
Guangshi's ships are also at Runzhou, and Shizhong will seize them first. The two generals will fall out—and that will corner the Song emperor.
Guangshi's ships are also at Runzhou, and Shizhong will seize them first. The two generals will fall out.
The words about cornering the Song emperor belong to the next sentence, s0196, not this one.

When Qi was founded, Jinan became Xingping Army command. Lin was made military commissioner, honored with the rank of Pillar of State with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, enfeoffed as Duke of Liang, appointed grand commander of all circuit forces, and given charge of Jinan Prefecture.

When Qi was founded, Jinan became Xingping Army command. Lin was made military commissioner, given the rank of Opening an Office with Ceremony Equal to the Three Excellencies, enfeoffed as Duke of Liang, appointed grand commander of all circuit forces, and given charge of Jinan Prefecture.
開府儀同三司 means opening an office with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies. It is not Pillar of State.

Before long he was appointed Director of Transport for the Northern Capital Circuit. He served successively as Director of Transport for the Central and Yanjing circuits, Vice Councilor, and Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat, then again as military commissioner of Xingping Army, Director of Transport for the Shangjing Circuit, and Pillar of State with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Han.

Before long he was appointed Director of Transport for the Northern Capital Circuit. He served successively as Director of Transport for the Central and Yanjing circuits, Vice Councilor, and Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat, then again as military commissioner of Xingping Army, Director of Transport for the Shangjing Circuit, and Opening an Office with Ceremony Equal to the Three Excellencies, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Han.
開府儀同三司 means opening an office with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies. It is not Pillar of State.

Dihu took Danzhou; Talan Julu; Aligua Zongcheng; Digubu Qingping and Linqing; Menggua Zhaozhou. Aligua swept through Xun, Hua, En, and Gaotang while detachments advanced on Ci and Xinde—all submitted.
浚 is Xunzhou. The English writes Xia.
Zongxian objected: "We hold their emperors and fathers captive. Their hatred is deep and long-standing.
Zongxian objected: "We took their fathers and elder brothers captive. Their hatred is deep and long-standing.
父兄 means fathers and elder brothers. Emperors is not in the text.
Invading Song he crossed the Huai. The Prince of Kang (Gaozong) sued for peace, submitted as a vassal, and accepted the Huai as the boundary—then the armies withdrew.
Invading Song he crossed the Huai. The Song King of Kang sued for peace, submitted as a vassal, and accepted the Huai as the boundary—then the armies withdrew.
宋康王 is the Song King of Kang. Gaozong is an added gloss.
